verdicts.reason: A is a mess: the headline and body copy sit on mismatched left/centre axes and the body is pushed off to the right. One divider floats on its own and the other is jammed into the contact line. The booking text is shrunk until it can't be read, the left half of the canvas and the band above the headline are empty, and everything is crammed into a narrow strip. B uses a readable two-column banner with legible text and the original dividers kept around the tagline. But it reads right-first: the headline sits top-right, above the right column rather than leading the layout, so the order runs from the tagline to the headline. The columns also don't share a baseline or top edge.
